A '''line company'''<ref name="ISB" /> or '''infantry company'''<ref name="TC">{{JournalCite|6|The Cure}}</ref> was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="ISB" /> When assigned to a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] to guard the [[Corps HQ]], the line company was referred to as a '''security company'''.<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref>

==Organization==
Commanded by a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], a line company was comprised of four [[line platoon]]s, a command element, and support personnel. The captain in command was assisted by four staff officers, each equivalent to a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in rank. The SC1 was the company lieutenant, the SC2 was the logistics officer, the SC3 was the medical officer, and the SC4 was the technical officer. The support element of the company included including eight personnel devoted to logistical matters, eleven technical personnel, and four medical personnel. One hundred and eighteen [[Droid/Legends|droids]] provided support.<ref name="ISB" />

The line company could be augmented by the addition of two [[assault platoon]]s, and two more [[line platoon]]s.<ref name="ISB2" /> In addition, if the company was expected to be deployed without support, more droids were assigned to the company.<ref name="ISB" />
